description: This file contains a JavaScript function used within the SuiteCRM system, specifically related to the Campaigns module. The function, set_return_prospect_list_and_save, interacts with form data after a popup reply, populating form fields, setting specific values related to the Campaigns module, and submitting the form to establish a relationship between campaigns and prospect lists.

methods.name: set_return_prospect_list_and_save(popup_reply_data)
methods.description: Handles form data received from a popup, populating form fields, and submitting the form to save the relationship between a campaign and a prospect list.
